title: Rav Huna bar Levai

paragraphs: Hyman mentions him in Berakhot 55b according to the Ein Yaakov reading; the Gemara has Rav Huna without further designation.[^1]

notes.text: The selected William Davidson digital paragraph of Berakhot 55b has plain Rav Huna. Hyman attributes the fuller Rav Huna bar Levai form to Ein Yaakov; that named edition has not been freshly collated here, and the selected paragraph does not establish which statement Hyman intended or an identity equivalence.
